proposed_core_edits.reason: The exact small-support catalogue is a load-bearing premise for the four displayed initial counts and is therefore added as a direct dependency.

proposed.justification: A geometric transfer law is the falsifiable enumeration consequence of the finite predecessor theorem.
proposed.gap: Finite hull counts can always be fit by an ad hoc recurrence; the claim requires the recurrence to be derived from the same sound and unique successor types.
proposed.consumer: Researchers can know catalogue size and generation cost before computing bounds at a chosen ordinal resolution.
